title: 换水问题
summary: 喝完 numBottles 瓶水后，每 numExchange 个空瓶可换一瓶水，求最多喝几瓶。
insight: 维护当前空瓶数；每轮批量兑换 empties/numExchange 瓶，喝完后新空瓶与余数合并，直到不足兑换。
pitfalls: 兑换得到的瓶子喝完仍产生空瓶
保留不能兑换的空瓶余数

solutions.title: 批量兑换模拟
solutions.idea: 每轮一次计算所有可兑换的新水。

code.java: class Solution { public int numWaterBottles(int numBottles,int numExchange){int answer=numBottles,empty=numBottles;while(empty>=numExchange){int full=empty/numExchange;answer+=full;empty=full+empty%numExchange;}return answer;} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int numWaterBottles(int numBottles,int numExchange){int answer=numBottles,empty=numBottles;while(empty>=numExchange){int full=empty/numExchange;answer+=full;empty=full+empty%numExchange;}return answer;} };
